addBasedNFT(address).details: This function can only be called by the owner.

params.nft: The address of the NFT contract to add.

addBondingCurve(address).details: This function can only be called by the FactoryManager.

params.bondingCurve: The address of the bonding curve to add.

emitBuy(address,address,uint256,uint256,.details: This function emits an event when a token is bought on the bonding curve. Can only be called by the BondingCurve contract.

params.deposit: The amount of ETH deposited for the purchase.
params.id: The unique identifier for the frontend (either Farcaster FID or Privy's DID).
params.sender: The address of the sender who bought the token.
params.token: The address of the token being bought.
params.unlockTime: The unlock time for the total bought tokens. This includes previous purchases, meaniong the time is additive. The locking blocks both token transfers and calling the sell function. It doesn't affect the buy function.

emitNewBondingCurveCreated(address,addre.details: This function emits an event when a new bonding curve is created. Can only be called by the FactoryManager.

params.creator: The address of the creator of the token.
params.curve: The address of the bonding curve to emit the event for.
params.id: The unique identifier for the frontend (either Farcaster FID or Privy's DID).
params.isDevLocked: Whether the developer's tokens are locked.
params.metadata: Additional metadata asociated with the token.
params.name: The name of the bonding curve token.
params.symbol: The symbol of the bonding curve token.
params.token: The address of the token associated with the bonding curve.

emitSell(address,address,uint256,uint256.details: This function emits an event when a token is sold on the bonding curve. Can only be called by the BondingCurve contract.

params.id: The unique identifier for the frontend (either Farcaster FID or Privy's DID).
params.reimbursement: The amount of ETH reimbursed to the sender.
params.sender: The address of the sender who sold the token.
params.token: The address of the token being sold.

returns._0: The address of the AddressChecker contract.

params._addressChecker: The address of the AddressChecker contract.
params._uniswapV3Migrator: The address of the Uniswap V3 migrator contract.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC-1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

params.dev: The address of the creator to receive rewards.

removeLastKingOfTheCasts().details: This function can only be called by the tracked BondingCurve contracts.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

uniswapV3Migrator().details: The UniswapV3Migrator contract is responsible for migrating liquidity from the bonding curves to Uniswap V3, when the funding goal is reached.

returns._0: The address of the UniswapV3Migrator contract.

updateKingOfTheCasts(address,bool).details: This function can only be called by the tracked BondingCurve contracts.

params.isCrowned: Whether the new king of the casts is crowned already or not.
params.newKingOfTheCasts: The address of the new king of the casts.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

withdrawDevRewards().details: Creator rewards are accumulated and can be withdrawn any time.

addBasedNFT(address).notice: Adds a new NFT to the list of based NFTs.

basedNFTs(uint256).notice: Gets the address of a based NFT by its index.

bondingCurves(address).notice: Checks if the given address is a registered bonding curve.

crownedCasts(address).notice: The bonding curve is holding the token. King of the casts requires the funding goal to be half-reached.

feePercent().notice: Returns the fee percentage for the bonding curves.

initialize(address,address,address,addre.notice: Initializes the contract with the Uniswap V3 migrator and address checker.

removeLastKingOfTheCasts().notice: Removes the last king of the casts.

updateKingOfTheCasts(address,bool).notice: Updates the current king of the casts.
